source.description: Imported from the published weapons CSV.

categories.name: Cannon
categories.description: Cannons offer a lot of short range volume for PD saturation, benefit significantly from a target lock / close pass (large salvo, low accuracy), and do not produce heat.

weapons.name: EFP Cluster
weapons.reasoning: Decent consumable short range and antimissile defence weapon. 1 damage means active armour is excellent resistance however. Uninterceptable (because efp). unusually notable increase in PD performance (via poor standard accuracy with large swarm size) if defending ships' fleet is dispersed for example.

weapons.name: Autocannon Array
weapons.reasoning: Turreted secondaries provide +1 acc, FCR lock at med range is a straight d10 swarm 3 roll - able to pressure equal tech PD nets in bulk. minimum damage that is able  to break through AA

weapons.name: Boosted Cannon
weapons.tagsDescription: Projectile, Durable(3), Strafe, Beam, Cold, Description
weapons.reasoning: Missile 3rd stage adapted not need seperated warheads. As a kinetic weapon, if properly supported by targetting and able to hit, despite the low velocity - this is a lot of mass, thus the strafe beam

weapons.name: PD Helium Bottle Gun
weapons.reasoning: Reusable versatile defence against all theats below armoured medium or larger craft threats. Strafe enables defeating reinforced light craft and torpedoes.

weapons.name: PD Hypervelocity Array
weapons.reasoning: Bulk defence only capable of non-reinforced targets

categories.name: LASER
categories.description: Lasers are multipart weapons with excellent accuracy but limited range, and significant damage falloff over range. Slightly smaller than normal emplacement requirements. Able to run extremely hot for unparalelled potential output within their limits.

weapons.name: Light Chemical LASER
weapons.reasoning: Flex disposables yo, that's pretty cool. Can hurt any target but suffers relative to the specialist options against their preferred targets.

weapons.name: Heavy Chemical LASER
weapons.reasoning: Look, strapping offensive weapons to Utility hulls does have it's limits, but two shots at T1 each for up to 12 damage in a single hit is sill pretty solid.

weapons.name: PD Chemical LASER
weapons.reasoning: Can defend from any munition or craft threat. Very bursty defence with oneshot4, going all-in it will save you from any single threat - once

weapons.name: Atomic LASER
weapons.reasoning: Reusable self-contained laser/reactor combo.

weapons.name: Light Atomic LASER
weapons.reasoning: Formidable up close, but lacks range as a secondary. Has beam.

weapons.name: Heavy Atomic LASER
weapons.reasoning: Best you can do at T1 for long range, sucks to be a laser user ig

weapons.name: PD Fission LASER
weapons.reasoning: Best accuracy of all T1 PD, but lacks for damage or mass. Probably will kill one missile every time tho

weapons.name: Heavy Optical Aperture
weapons.reasoning: No primary option. Secondary with LR if UVASER else still refirable at MR and dangerous per beam+generator refire ability in green

weapons.name: PD Optical Aperture
weapons.reasoning: Accuracy as a railgun, no charges needed and cannot be intercepted. Difficulty engaging reinforced targets compared to pd rail, but can do it. Better vs bulk threats esp with Refire as it can only ever engage one target (eg bulk swarm) per engagement. Gains laser gimmicks

weapons.name: Heavy Multiplex Aperture
weapons.reasoning: ER only gained with UVASER gen or better. FEL reaches it's full potential

weapons.name: PD Multiplex Aperture
weapons.reasoning: Comfy halfway point for killing reinforced targets, still not actually good at is as the first hit is refused, but follow on hits incl. from reengagements can burn through reinforced torps without further difficulty. Multiuse rather than Refire means it's a good upgrade over the optical aperture despite stats not changing - can engage x number of maneuverable targets, craft, or bulk projectiles rather than just a single salvo or craft. Minimum 3 attacks to kill a reinforced heavy torp as 7 hits required. We're at T3 here so the many many successes this can generate by reengaging seem warranted. Multiuse (activate several times/round per utility), Multiuse(Generator) (Activate against multiple targets/engagement)

weapons.name: Light Array Aperture
weapons.reasoning: Scaling up to secondary/primary. Terminal allows swarm hits to act as beam.

weapons.name: Heavy Array Aperture
weapons.reasoning: Flex makes this group extremely competent against any missile/craft threat

weapons.name: PD Array Aperture
weapons.reasoning: T4, Exceptionally accurate and can engage everything except reinforced (swarm, no screen or terminal) targets to great effect. Pretty much the kind of thing you need if you're getting smacked by a mag ring

weapons.name: Light Beam Aperture
weapons.reasoning: Primary/spinal. 4acc @ MR if turreted

weapons.name: Main Beam Aperture 01
weapons.reasoning: max 6 successes/attack at ER. Overload so that you can feel extremely powerful.

weapons.name: Spinal Beam Aperture 02
weapons.reasoning: Accuracy doesn't change, mirror reaches it's functional limit sans diminishing returns. Extreme SR accuracy, damage increases across all ranges as size increases as cooling is more plentiful. Damage/heat increases in efficiency at all ranges

weapons.name: PD Beam Aperture
weapons.reasoning: Still antimissile class 3, but peak accuracy and gains blast. On a good shot (30% chance) and a locked target this can burn through a reinforced heavy torp. Range still v limited.

weapons.name: MASER Generator
weapons.reasoning: Applies to all generators, consecutively reengaging a single target with the same unique aperture allows the hits of each attack to be treated as if they were from the same attack for apertures with Beam

weapons.name: FEL Generator
weapons.reasoning: These are significant accuracy modifiers across all generators, but the damage seems more modest. Strafe Beam or Salvo on the weapons themselves multiply the damage listed in effect.

weapons.name: HASER Generator
weapons.reasoning: Charge to pierce because hyperspace. Charges required as the size of the generator.

categories.name: Energetic (LASER/Kinetic)
categories.description: Energetic weapons have range and are self contained as kinetics, not requiring a generator, but remain direct fire. They have improved accuracy over kinetics but do have damage falloff

weapons.name: Light XRASER
weapons.reasoning: So these are kinda similar to the atomic lasers, ain't they. Terminal to allow overflow to escorts. Excelent acc available from turreting, limited effective range. More than multiplex, less than helcoil

weapons.name: Heavy XRASER
weapons.tagsDescription: Charge to Strafe, Attenuate, Overload, Charge to Refire(1)
weapons.reasoning: T3 impacting performance relative to main option below. Requires more heat to operate, but can operate more than the light and further out.

weapons.name: Main XRASER
weapons.tagsDescription: Charge to Blast, Attenuate, Overload, Fragile to Refire(1)
weapons.reasoning: Significant damage fallof until comparible with above.

weapons.name: Heavy GRASER
weapons.tagsDescription: Charge to Blast, Attenuate, Overload, Charge to Refire(1)

weapons.name: Main GRASER
weapons.tagsDescription: Charge, Blast, Attenuate, Overload, Fragile to Refire(1)

weapons.name: Main Star Cannon 01
weapons.reasoning: Pulsar Cannon

weapons.name: Spinal Star Cannon 02
weapons.reasoning: Blitzar Cannon

weapons.name: Spinal Star Cannon 03
weapons.reasoning: Quasar Cannon

categories.name: Kinetic
categories.description: Kinetic weapons have consistent damage over range and attempt to oversaturate point defence. Slightly less accurate than particles, moderate accuracy falloff ,and middling range per tech. Partially mitigate displacement via steer but are almost all interceptable.

weapons.name: Light Chemrail
weapons.reasoning: if used reactively, should be able to sufficiently overwhelm craft agressors charged in preperation. Remains easily defeatable by AA.

weapons.name: Heavy Chemrail
weapons.reasoning: Autocannon but railgun-ified, smaller but more capable at MR salvos and potentially twice as many/weapon, slightly improved accuracy. Comes at a cost of heat compared to their cold T0 counterparts. Between the small salvo and low LR accuracy, unlikely to be able to generate more than two hits/salvo with FCR lock at LR.

weapons.name: Versatile Chemrail
weapons.reasoning: For what it is, I gave this less range than the secondary to be thematic with the smaller salvos and larger, slower projectiles because they consist of nukes (which are functionally light torps sans propulsion). Increased accuracy over the boosted cannon because the tech is improved, but the range is comparible. Significantly improved potential damage over T0 primary.

weapons.name: PD Chemrail
weapons.reasoning: 1 point more accurate. Sufficiently limited volume compared with T0 allows this to be intercepted - not an issue unless AMMs are mixed in or you're defending a close pass vs direct PD.

weapons.name: Light Railgun
weapons.tagsDescription: Flex, Hybrid, Charge to Strafe, Durable(2)
weapons.reasoning: Start actually using the established secondary/primary paradigm here. As Dispersed PD it has 1 acc vs threats without offset support, but at least can function independently unlike the light chemrail. Hybrid means it is a direct weapon as PD and cannot be intercepted by ships

weapons.name: Heavy Railgun
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Charge to Strafe, Fragile to Refire(1), Durable(3)
weapons.reasoning: Railguns gain SR accuracy and longer range than coils. Coils are more consistent across range as they're guided, but lack speed for rail range

weapons.name: Fissile Railgun
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Charge(1), Blast, Fragile to Refire (1), Durable(3)
weapons.reasoning: After shooting, gain fragile to shoot again. This disables the weapon after the double tap. Damage potential like this is unparalelled per size except by torpedoes at LR and ER at T2

weapons.name: PD Railgun
weapons.tagsDescription: Antimissile, Screen, Hybrid, Charge to Strafe
weapons.reasoning: Hybrid makes this functionally uninterceptable when used as PD against missile, but interceptable by self defence PD by craft. Can reliably engage and damage any craft or munition target including other projectile or munition antimissile weapons - first reusable PD weapon able to damage armoured medium+ craft.

weapons.name: Versatile Coilgun
weapons.tagsDescription: Projectile, Blast, Steer(2), Refire(1), Durable(2), Description
weapons.reasoning: Able to boost missile range up to from Long (that's insane, idk but we'll leave it here to prompt conversation). All of these versatile weapons have the compromise of staging a more durable weapon in a less durable 3rd stage, increasing their vulnerability to gain range, however as kinetics also rely on PD penetration, these versatile weapons could create threatening decoy salvoes.

weapons.name: PD Coilgun
weapons.reasoning: Compared to the railgun, this can engage more targets and score more independent hits, and both are able to penetrate reinforced missile and light craft targets (though only the PD rail can daamge Medium+ armoured craft). First PD with medium range, though short range performance vs bulk threats remains comparible to T0 hypervelocity / T1 chemrail.

weapons.name: Light Helical Driver
weapons.tagsDescription: Flex, Hybrid, Strafe, Charge to Refire(1)

weapons.name: Heavy Helical Driver
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Strafe, Steer(2), Charge to Refire(1)

weapons.name: Nuclear Helical Driver
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Blast, Steer(3), Charge to Refire(2), Durable(2)

weapons.name: PD Helical Driver
weapons.tagsDescription: Antimissile, Projectile, Charge to Salvo(2), Screen, Terminal
weapons.reasoning: First kientic PD able to engage twice per defence, good at any PD target

weapons.name: Main Helical Driver 01
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Steer(2), Charge to Refire(2), Durable(2), Overload
weapons.reasoning: Velocity, Guidance, and a swarm come together to allow vital point targetting. Once armour is eventually breached, this is better able to degrade and immobilise targets.

weapons.name: Spinal Helical Driver 02
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Steer(2), Charge to Refire(2), Durable(2), Overload
weapons.reasoning: likely not survivable enough at range for their opportunity cost

weapons.name: Spinal Helical Driver 03
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Steer(2), Charge to Refire(2), Durable(2), Overload

weapons.name: Spinal Helical Driver 04
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Steer(2), Charge to Refire(2), Durable(2), Overload

weapons.name: Spinal Helical Driver 05
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Steer(2), Charge to Refire(2), Durable(2), Overload

weapons.name: Light Macron Gun
weapons.reasoning: Requires a charge before any use. If activated in the ship phase it affects ship and armoured craft targets equally as Class 1. Very capable as a defensive PD weapon vs bulk threats including durable ones, but is either offensive or defensive each round and can only be activated once/round (flex) unlike other antimissile weapons. Has reliable but limited effect as PD due to small swarm size and secondary weapon emplacement volume. Can engage missiles/torps/light craft as Class 3 via antimissile or reinforced torps/light craft with -3 acc via Dispersed. Cannot effect Armoured Medium+ in missile resolution phase.

weapons.name: Heavy Macron Gun
weapons.reasoning: Loses Flex, but gains range. Not a bad weapon to have as an option considering it's a direct fire high damage reusable swarm, though heat intensive (Charge required and primary sized).

weapons.name: Main Thermonuclear Torch 01
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Charge(1), Safe, Beam, Blast, Terminal

weapons.name: Spinal Thermonuclear Torch 02
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Charge(1), Safe, Salvo(2), Beam, Blast, Terminal

weapons.name: Spinal Thermonuclear Torch 03
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Charge(1), Safe, Salvo(3), Beam, Blast, Terminal
weapons.reasoning: First kinetic weapon to increase beyond 1:1 in salvo:heat efficiency relative to baseline. scary keep-away gun, but significantly reduced threat without accuracy bonus

weapons.name: Spinal Thermonuclear Torch 04
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Charge(1), Safe, Salvo(4), Beam, Blast, Terminal

weapons.name: Spinal Thermonuclear Torch 05
weapons.tagsDescription: Hybrid, Charge(1), Safe, Salvo(5), Beam, Blast, Terminal

weapons.name: Main Wave Motion Cannon 01
weapons.reasoning: Requires and pulls from hyperdrive to do its thing

categories.name: Plasma (Kintetic/Particle)
categories.description: Plasma weapons inherit range. They're slow and interceptable but trade accuracy for significant durability and overclock-ability (charge to x, sometimes multiple)

weapons.name: Light Plasma Cannon
weapons.reasoning: If turreted, this is the most accurate plasma at all ranges except Extended. No charge required - damage falls off significantly and limited steer. Still puts a lot of durability in the air for it's size.

weapons.name: Heavy Plasma Cannon
weapons.tagsDescription: Projectile, Charge to Blast, Steer(2), Durable(5)
weapons.reasoning: For the PD absorbsion this puts up per emplacement, it does run very hot if you also want it do do damage. (Charge to refire, Charge once each for those shots to blast, and the fire cost itself allows this weapon to pull up to 15 (min 9) instability to put 14 points of PD cohesion of the field.

weapons.name: Main Plasma Cannon 01
weapons.tagsDescription: Charge(1), Projectile, Charge to Blast, Steer(1), Evasive, Durable(9)
weapons.reasoning: 8 instability for 10 cohesion with blast

weapons.name: Spinal Plasma Cannon 02
weapons.tagsDescription: Charge(1), Projectile, Charge to Blast, Steer(1), Evasive, Durable(6), Charge to Refire(1)
weapons.reasoning: 18 cohesion in flight if you can pay the 7 counts of instability (35 total)

weapons.name: Spinal Plasma Cannon 03
weapons.tagsDescription: Charge(2), Projectile, Charge to Blast, Steer(1), Evasive, Durable(7), Reinforced, Charge to Refire(1)
weapons.reasoning: Less cohesion but gain reinforced. That PD boat better be packing class 2 or Dispersed defence, else I hope it's fast. Accuracy and low steer allows this still to have one simple solution to defeat at range.

weapons.name: Spinal Plasma Cannon 04
weapons.tagsDescription: Charge(3), Projectile, Charge to Blast, Steer(1), Evasive, Durable(9), Salvo(2)
weapons.reasoning: Reset back to 1 but salvo goes up. Repeat 1-3 progression from here gain +1 salvo per 3.

weapons.name: Spinal Plasma Cannon 05
weapons.tagsDescription: Charge(3), Projectile, Charge to Blast, Steer(1), Evasive, Durable(6), Salvo(2), Charge to Refire(1)
weapons.reasoning: full use instability at 108 total, but can put out 10*2*2 cohesion, optionally split on up to two targets. Heat per effect trends up as size per effect trends down

weapons.name: Magnetic Ring
weapons.reasoning: internally stabilisez plasma projectiles physically timed to breakdown into projectiles shy of the target to impact. High volume bulk threat. Accuracy, Swarm size, and Damage all degrade with distance as they consume the same underlying capacity of each projectile. Deterioration though is low, as it's spread over each of these.

weapons.name: PD Magnetic Ring
weapons.reasoning: Familiar? It's the PD EFP cluster from T0 but it's all grown up now - reusable, larger salvoes etc. Still beat on mount denstiy tho. Benefits massively from targetting data. T4 is comparible with the PD Phaser. Lacking range; it's not actually able to demonstrate it's lineage from Particles except by it's very large swarm because it's much easier to handle than solid kinetics. Charge before use means out of turn it's only good for one activation. Still utility antimissile tho so ig you could go zooming around on your turn and bonking salvoes left and right before they could resolve. Gotta imagine tracking for these is at least a little bit of a bother vs evading threats (like missiles) and their lack of reprogramability or external guidance makes baseline acc poor for tech level. Lock on the threat and any craft or munition salvo is fair game. had an idle thought that this kinda presents as an amorphous seeking claymore mine

weapons.name: Spinal Corona Cannon 02
weapons.reasoning: Reusable missile standoff warhead

categories.name: Particle
categories.description: Particle weapons gain range very early, should lead to better critical effects, and have shallow accuracy falloff, but are limited often in maximum damage output, run hot, or use larger emplacement configurations.

weapons.name: Electron Gun
weapons.reasoning: Here's a T1 Tertiary weapon with long range if you can stack the accuracy. That's the whole bit.

weapons.name: Electron Repeater
weapons.reasoning: Compared to the chemrail, this has higher maximum damage per salvo and cannot be shot down. The chemrail can get more heat inefficient (charge to refire) and put out two salvoes however, significantly outperforming this weapon in maximum damage, but chemrail salvoes can be intercepted.

weapons.name: LINAC
weapons.reasoning: slower but more coherent than the torac, so worse accuracy but better range. these still ultimately are very fast.

weapons.name: PD TORAC
weapons.reasoning: Gains range per particle gimmick, but cannot hit MR missile targets without a 3rd ship present for coincidence or the salvo being locked. Best case against the worst target has 1 damage dealt to a reinforced torpedo or light craft with a target lock after rolling a 1.

weapons.name: H TORAC
weapons.tagsDescription: Charge(2), Strafe, Beam, Cascade, Overload, Charge to Refire(3)

weapons.name: Main TUR LINAC 01
weapons.reasoning: Accuracy still comparible to LINAC and others as it scales up in emplacement size instead. Range is beat by the larger helcoils as they're guided and this isn't, likewise this is a particle stream and loses damage over range. Not interceptable however so maybe that's worth it.

weapons.name: Small TUR LINAC
weapons.reasoning: Large felxible defensive weapon. Is emplacement, so only activated once. Lock your ship, reinforced plasma or torp target however and you can put 21 damage on it in the missile res phase, or defend from up to 7 durable(3) projectiles in the bulk salvo.

weapons.name: Muon Gun
weapons.reasoning: Secondary weapon with extreme range, but very hot to use.

weapons.name: Main Hadron Cannon 01
weapons.reasoning: Very hot to reach it's potential, but all of the benefits of everything prior. Unusually (for a particle) it increases in emplacement efficiency.

weapons.name: Spinal Hadron Cannon 04
weapons.reasoning: Single salvo vs a single target this is somewhat similar to a longer range Thermonuke torch - more damage per hit but no beam.

weapons.name: Spinal Hadron Cannon 05
weapons.reasoning: Charge +1 Salvo +1

weapons.name: PD Graviton Cannon
weapons.tagsDescription: wierd putting attenuate here if it's a laser/kinetic thing

categories.name: Ionic (Particle/LASER)
categories.description: Ionic weapons have all of the benefits and drawbacks of both lasers and particles, large emplacement requirements, generator requirements, instability generation, and relatively low damage per size in exchange for extreme short accuracy with limited or inverse damage falloff, effective range, critical effects, and increased per weapon potential attack output

weapons.name: Particle Collimator
weapons.tagsDescription: Charge(1), Hybrid, Strafe, Beam, Safe, Cascade, Generator
weapons.reasoning: Laser assisted sandblaster. Charge required so the first shot isn't actually free per the generator/aperture rule, but it is half the price of follow up shots.

weapons.name: PD Particle Collimator
weapons.reasoning: PD Torac (T2) + PD Optical Aperture (T2)

weapons.name: Spinal RELVAC Collimator 02
weapons.tagsDescription: Adaptive, Charge(1), Blast, Beam, Cascade, Overload, Steer(1), Generator
weapons.reasoning: With the magic of the phased array, this splits the particle beam into multiple salvoes. Very very hot per shot - even more than plasma. In tags and effects this is a combo of the phased array aperture, hadron cannon, and just a pinch of beam. Based on how the phaser goes with limited range, it stops contributing to damage and only functions as an accelerator and guide beam beyond MR

weapons.name: Spinal RELVAC Collimator 03
weapons.tagsDescription: Adaptive, Charge(2), Blast, Beam, Charge to Salvo(2), Cascade, Overload, Steer(1), Generator
weapons.reasoning: This one is pretty silly, and I'm sure you'll make at least a few funny faces if you consider it. Flex makes it pretty unique, but consider at those extreme ranges the difficulty of gaining those locks on munition targets as they don't ever have heat. Should not be possible to use as an antimissile weapon at ER except for targets surrounded by 3 ships + shooter, or with the hazer gen for 1 free hit on a miss. no default blast means reinforced targets are usually safe, and this is forward firing only. Big damage does not mean multiple hits, and this loses the ability to kill bulk threats as range increases and multiple hit potential goes down. DR requires hazer for any target, unless locked with FEL generator. Can never earn more than one hit per salvo at DR

weapons.name: Spinal RELVAC Collimator 04
weapons.tagsDescription: Adaptive, Charge(3), Blast, Beam, Charge to Salvo(3), Cascade, Overload, Steer(1), Generator
weapons.reasoning: For all of it's incredible effects it is still limitied by a phased array core. (to be clear, this does scare me when paired with a haser.)

weapons.name: Spinal RELVAC Collimator 05
weapons.tagsDescription: Adaptive, Charge(4), Blast, Beam, Charge to Salvo(4), Cascade, Overload, Steer(1), Generator
weapons.reasoning: For all of it's incredible effects it is still limitied by a phased array core. (to be clear, this does scare me when paired with a haser.)

weapons.name: Small RELVAC Collimator
weapons.tagsDescription: Adaptive, Charge to Blast, Beam, Generator
weapons.reasoning: Primary sized pd only reusable because of the generator rules. Very effective for only the first out of turn activation via charge requirement. Cannot defeat reinforced targets without charging. Tech 5 PD, sibling to beam pd. Reusable but hot af. Primary size justifies this not actually being useful as an antimissile weapon at short range. Built on a multiplex guide beam and not a phased array one because it's whole thing is range.

categories.name: Troops
categories.description: Troop weapons have a range of 0, not short, and must be simple to resolve. No swarms. Usually Class 3, occasionally Class 2. Good accuracy as they do not use thermal rating or correlation to their benefit.

categories.name: Craft
categories.description: Craft weapons are alike ship weapons but with more limited range and worse accuracy. They do not benefit from thermal rating or correlation because they're usually very close to their target and have their real position, but do benefit from massed strikes, with multiple craft in a wing each contributing +1 to the attack accuracy instead of an additional attack. Some weapons can attack ships, but not all, and these weapons are also more effective vs many craft.
